subject: Ops playbook: tier ascend and rate-smoothing for Nimbus renewal
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@nimblenimbus.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling plan for Q1 — hosted commits and SLA alignment

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the deep dive last week. We ran internal projections and expect to need a ~3.5x increase in peak token throughput starting Jan 2027 as we roll the new personalization surface to 20% of traffic. Concretely, we're looking at moving from a 1.2M token monthly commit to ~4.2M, and we'd like to lock an annual term (12 months) that smooths monthly rate bands and preserves burst capacity during promo weeks.

Two asks to help us decide quickly:
- A clean SOW and pricing table reflecting the larger commit and a stepped rate band (monthly buckets)
- Confirmation on burst windows and an SLA credit mechanism if latency SLOs are missed during traffic surges

We can move to signature within two weeks of having final pricing + a simple migration/rollout ops plan. Can you also include typical uplift timelines and any recommended canary strategy?

Attaching our expected traffic cadence separately in follow-up.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of AI Platform
Nimbus Retail
priya@nimblenimbus.com

---

Note: external recipient list includes our procurement contact at contracts@nimbleretail.com
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Priya Sharma <priya@nimblenimbus.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling plan for Q1 — hosted commits and SLA alignment

Hi Priya — appreciate the clarity. 

Quick responses:
- We'll put together an SOW and a rate-band spreadsheet that models a stepped monthly bucket for the 4.2M token baseline and a separate promo-burst pool.
- Burst windows: we support short-term burst capacity (2–4x for ~48-hour windows) with pre-warming and a soft-rate gating policy. We can add a formal burst addendum to the SOW.
- SLA credits: we have a tiered SLA credit schedule tied to per-route latency SLOs; I'll map that to your critical routes and include an example calculation in the SOW.

Operationally, I recommend a 3-stage rollout: canary (5% traffic for 1 week), ramp (25% for 2 weeks), full flip. We'll include KV cache warmup and an autoscaling pre-seed plan for the canary to avoid cold-start amplification.

I'll coordinate a draft SOW and attach a rate workbook for transparency. Laura will lead the commercial line items.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Priya Sharma <priya@nimblenimbus.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Draft SOW + rate model (NIM renewal)

Priya — attaching a draft SOW and the rate_band_calc workbook that models committed vs overage bands across the 12‑month term. Highlights below:

- Baseline monthly commit: 4.2M tokens (annualized)
- Stepped rate bands: 0–1.5M, 1.5–3.5M, 3.5–5.0M with unit token pricing per band
- Promo burst pool: 800k token buffer per month plus ad-hoc 48‑hour burst credit (up to 4x), with pre-paid burst credits available
- SLA: 99.9% route latency SLO for critical endpoints; SLA credit ladder included in section 4.2 of the SOW
- Migration credit: proposed one-time $10k bill credit to offset initial on‑boarding throttles and engineering time

Attachments: [Attachment: Nimbus_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: rate_band_calc.xlsx (Excel)]

If the economics look good we'll convert to a signature-ready DocuSign envelope. We're intentionally conservative on the first quarter ramp to give engineering time to validate throughput.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Priya Sharma <priya@nimblenimbus.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@nimbleretail.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + rate model (NIM renewal)

Laura / Jonas — thanks, reviewed the SOW and the workbook. A few items from Procurement that need explicit language before legal greenlights: 
1) Burst credits: we need guaranteed availability (not subject to other customers' burst usage) for the first 90 days after go-live, or an equivalent guaranteed pre-warmed capacity.
2) SLA credits: can you add an example calculation that assumes sustained >2s 95th latency on a critical route during a 12‑hour promo surge? Procurement wants the dollar-equivalent credit.
3) Term: we prefer a 24-month commitment in exchange for a modest unit price reduction (we can discuss percent).

Also, can you confirm whether data retention for KV caches can be set to 30 days for our environment (we're in EU+US regions, sharded)?

On the migration credit — Procurement is receptive but asks that it be applied against the first invoice rather than as a separate credit token.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Priya
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Priya Sharma <priya@nimblenimbus.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, finance@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + rate model (NIM renewal)

Priya — thanks for the precise asks. Looping in Aditya (revenue) and Finance/Legal to confirm the contractual language; quick notes from our side: 
- Burst availability: we can offer a guaranteed pre-warmed capacity commitment for the first 90 days (sized per the attached workbook). We'll add explicit language to the SOW to exclude other customers from that pool for the initial post-launch window.
- SLA dollar credits: Laura will add a worked example; legal prefers a cap but we'll show both the uncapped calculation and a capped example for negotiation.
- Term: we can offer a 24-month option with a 7% unit price reduction on committed tokens vs the 12-month baseline; Aditya, please confirm margin & approval.
- Data retention: engineering confirms KV cache TTL configurable to 30 days for your dedicated environment; we'll mark region-specific retention and HSM/KMS controls in the Private Controls appendix.

Action items:
1) Laura to update SOW + workbook with burst pool sizing and SLA worked example (attachments updated).
2) Aditya + Finance to sign off on 24-month pricing (Jonas to follow up by Monday).
3) I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope once we agree final terms.

[Attachment: approval_note.pdf (internal approval memo)]

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Priya Sharma <priya@nimblenimbus.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@nimbleretail.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700

Team — we appreciate the quick alignment. Procurement has approved the 24-month term if the 7% reduction is documented and burst guarantees are explicit. Legal signed off contingent on the SLA example and pre-warmed guarantee being added to the SOW.

I'm attaching an internal approval note for our team and will watch for the DocuSign envelope. Once signed, can we schedule a kickoff for Dec 6 (30-day pre-warm and canary on Dec 13)?

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/env/ABC123

Best,
Priya Sharma
Head of AI Platform
Nimbus Retail
